Codes 1-2047 are used to encode the TMC Events. IconSetId = Event Id = TMC Event Code
Codes 65536-131071 are used to encode TPEG-TEC Events. IconSetId = Event Id = 65536 + TEC table number * 256 + TEC event code
Codes 131072-196607 are used to encode VICS Causes. IconSetId = 131.072 (0x20000) + cause * 256 + causeDetail
Codes 196608-262143 are used to encode VICS Restrictions. IconSetId = 196608 (0x30000) + restriction * 256 + restrictionDetail
Codes 262144-262399 are used to encode VICS Parking Lot States. IconSetId = 262144 (0x40000) + parkingLotState
Codes 262400-262410 are used to encode VICS Emergency. IconSetId = 262400 (0x40100) + emergency kind
Attention: Do not use numbers above 0xfff ffff (268.435.455), because four bits are used for flags by the mapviewer
The 22 Icon Columns contain the icon filenames (relative to TrafficEventInfos.csv file) of the respective icon variant
Icon Priority: 0 = lowest priority, 255 = highest priority. Values < 0 and > 255 are invalid. Unset means 0.
Announcement id: Id for the LASER module for spoken traffic announcements
